name: misbehaving target (ignores SIGTERM, leaks a setsid-escaped child)
spawn:
import os,signal,time
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
pf=os.environ.get('VELDO_PIDFILE')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
    os.setsid()
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
    time.sleep(30)
    os._exit(0)
if pf:
    open(pf,'a').write(str(pid)+chr(10))
while True:
    time.sleep(30)
